about_the_game:
Gear up for battle in this Army-themed pinball table, featuring intense military action and strategic gameplay!

🎖️ Authentic Army design – Play on a battlefield-inspired table with military vehicles, bases, and combat zones.
🔫 Mission-based gameplay – Complete tactical objectives to earn bonuses and high scores.
🛞 Two ramps and bumpers – Master precision shots to navigate the table’s strategic layout.
💣 Explosive bonus features – Unlock special rewards and high-scoring opportunities through skilled play.
🧩 Challenging puzzles – Solve interactive table mechanics for extra points.
⚙️ Realistic pinball physics, including multi-ball action.
🏆 Steam high score tracking – Prove your skills and dominate the leaderboards.
🎶 Military-themed soundtrack, featuring intense music, battlefield sound effects, and commanding voices.
🎵 Music-controlled levels, where the action syncs dynamically to the soundtrack.

Instructions: ( Keyboard Keys )

S - Left Flipper

D - Left Tilt

L - Right Flipper

K - Right Tilt

Enter - Ball Plunge
